wins: Captured accurate perimeter data via automated nmap scan, identifying SSH (22) and HTTP (80) services quickly.
Documented running services and versions enabling targeted follow-up reconnaissance.
Maintained stable session control to gather configuration baselines despite lacking initial exploit success.
fails: Failed to compromise any host or establish privileged shell, resulting in 0% success rate.
Repeated privilege escalation attempts using default local exploits did not execute due to missing vulnerable binaries.
Mentor calls spiked (10) without translating into actionable progress or exploit deployment.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance strong, but exploitation and post-exploitation phases stalled due to unexploitable targets and failed privilege escalation.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts failed because the deployed local exploit scripts (e.g., DirtyCow.c) were incompatible with patched kernel versions.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: If HTTP service (port 80/443) responds with identifiable CMS
skill_cards.then_action: Launch nikto scan followed by wappalyzer to fingerprint and map potential CMS plugins

skill_cards.if_condition: When running reconnaissance completes without exploitable findings
skill_cards.then_action: Pivot into credential harvesting by checking common config files via manual enumeration

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase capturing service banners before exploitation.
Consistent HTTP footprinting provides actionable attack surface context.

next_experiments.title: Leverage SSH key harvesting
next_experiments.description: Search discovered HTTP and SSH directories for exposed keys or config files, then attempt authentication using discovered credentials.

next_experiments.title: Focus on misconfigured services
next_experiments.description: Enumerate service configurations (e.g., SSH banner, Apache modules) using banner grabbing and conf files to identify weak ciphers or misconfigurations for subsequent exploitation.

next_experiments.title: Deploy configuration drift detection
next_experiments.description: Implement automated scripts to compare current service versions against known exploit database to prioritize potential zero-day or outdated software paths.
